rounds.oldMeaning: Bekusho kucedza, kudla noma kushabalalisa intfo. Kwakungashiwo nangemlilo, sifo noma imphi.
rounds.story: Kucala leligama belibanti ekucedzeni intfo. Kancane kancane lagcila kakhulu ekudleni kwabantfu, laba ngulokushiwo sidlo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Bekusho umuntfu lofundzisako noma locondzisako ekufundzeni.
rounds.story: Lelivi lavela emfundzisweni nje. Ngesikhatsi setithunywa telisontfo, lagcila kakhulu kumholi welisontfo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Bekusho umhlangano wabantfu, sicumbi noma indzawo lapho kubutsanelwa khona.
rounds.story: Bekungumhlangano nje. Ekukhuleni kwemaKhristu, leligama lasetjentiswa kakhulu kubhekisa esontfweni.

rounds.oldMeaning: Bekuyintsambo yensimbi noma luhlelo lwetintsambo lolusetjentiselwa kubopha noma kuvimba.
rounds.story: Tekucocisana takucala betihamba ngetincingo. Ngako ligama lacala kumela ifoni noma lushayelo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Bekusho sikhala sekungena noma kuphuma endlini.
rounds.story: Kucala bekungumnyango wangempela. Emabhovisi nasembusweni, lagcina selimele litiko noma sabelo.

rounds.oldMeaning: Bekusho noma ngumuphi umshini lowenta umsebenti.
rounds.story: Kubantfu labanyenti, umshini lowavama kubona nsuku tonkhe kwaba yimoto. Ngako lelivi lancipha laba yigama lemoto.
Inhloko yemtimba yaholela esifanisweni semholi. Kancane kancane yasetjentiswa kubaphatsi nalabahola labanye.

rounds.oldMeaning: Bekubhekisa ekuhambeni kwemabutfo noma lulungiselelo lwemphi.
rounds.story: Kusukela etimphini, leligama langena epolitiki nasemphakatsini. Nyalo livame kusho umsebenti wekukhutsata.
Kucala bekubantfu lababala. Ngemuva kwaloko, leligama laniketwa umshini lowenta lowo msebenti.

rounds.oldMeaning: Bekusho likamelo lelincane noma indzawo levalekile.
rounds.story: Ligama lalisho likamelo lelincane lelimnyama. Ekuthwebuleni titfombe lagcina selibita sitfwebuli setitfombe.

rounds.oldMeaning: Bekuyisilinganiso sesisindvo, futsi kwesinye sikhatsi kwakusho imali yasendvulo.
rounds.story: Ngefanekiso lebhayibhelini, imali lebitwa kanjalo yahunyushwa njengemnikelo wemuntfu. Kancane kancane laba likhono.
Lesisetjentiswa sekhompyutha sasinentambo lebukeka njengemsila. Ngako sagcina sesibitwa ngalelo gama.
